title: Wave 0 application architecture preservation boundary
question: Which application entrypoints, package boundaries, and registrations must Wave 0 preserve, and which exact changes are actually required by MR-IMPL-001?

frozenPlan.exactRequiredChange: Preserve the mapped implementation and its runtime registrations while future changes remain within the locked plan boundary.

preservedArchitecture.generatedOutputBoundary: Each production frontend bundle cleans and recreates its package dist directory; dist output is generated and non-authoritative.

pathReconciliation.conclusion: The task path boundary does not reconcile with its contract owner or the actual build entry graph.

externalPrimaryEvidence.conclusion: The official pinned source confirms the index.tsx-to-App and multi-entry Electron renderer topology.

materialConclusions.conclusion: All 33 task-linked runtime registrations are current and exact.
MR-IMPL-001 is a KEEP task whose current and target path sets are identical; no Codebase rewrite is justified.
The hash-matching @affine/core/package.json contains neither the claimed MR_CAP_001_CoreSymbol nor its claimed export-interface anchor.
The capability owner, task allowed paths, actual build entrypoints, and acceptance tests are semantically inconsistent.
After authorized repair, MR-IMPL-001 should execute as a preservation/verification gate with zero application source mutations unless later evidence proves a scoped adaptation necessary.

contradictions.description: Frozen authority claims a TypeScript interface in a JSON manifest where the literal symbol and anchor do not exist.
The contract owner path is absent from task allowed paths and is therefore forbidden by the catch-all rule, while the task paths point elsewhere.
Eight actual Rspack entry source files are proven by the build map and live bundler but omitted from the task exact/allowed path sets.
The unit test requires the nonexistent symbol, and the integration test requires undefined generic state persistence for a KEEP architecture capability.

hardBlockers.reason: The frozen MR-CAP-001/MR-IMPL-001 architecture owner and proof boundary are semantically contradictory and cannot produce truthful Wave 0 receipts.

softRisks: Four of sixteen targeted active/reference files are version deltas; they need ordinary Wave 0 preservation checks after authority repair.
Offline/cloud-adjacent registrations remain assigned to MR-INV-005 and were not reclassified here.
decision: BLOCKED pending the one authorized fresh independent review. Third-attempt source/canonical/projection synchronization, complete certification, Step 11b, and semantic pre-review gate have passed.
implementationConsequence: NO CODEBASE MUTATION. After authorized change control, MR-IMPL-001 should be a preservation/verification gate unless new scoped evidence proves an adaptation is required.
requiredResolution: Replace the nonexistent MR_CAP_001_CoreSymbol with truthful source anchors or an explicit non-symbol preservation marker.
Reconcile capability ownership with task exact/current/target/allowed paths and actual Rspack entries.
Classify true entry sources, worker inputs, and generated dist outputs.
Rewrite the two MR-CAP-001 acceptance tests around the real architecture contract.
Add literal-anchor and owner/path semantic validator challenges.
Rerun full authorized frozen change-control certification and independent review.
